summary.name: Akii Technologies portfolio
summary.one_liner: Portfolio page for Akii Technologies, a venture builder whose four portfolio companies include Marquorum, Revenue Scout, the Akii SEO Plugin, and the Entreprehardship podcast.
use_cases: audit a website for SEO and AI search readiness
find and fix broken links on a site
plan content and group keywords around user questions
find prospects from public social conversations
promote recurring-work AI services as an affiliate
listen to a podcast about entrepreneurship hardships
summary.what_it_does: The page is a portfolio overview for Akii Technologies, which describes itself as a venture builder that creates and grows its portfolio companies, each owning its own product and customers. Revenue Scout researches public social conversations, explains why each match may fit, prepares social replies for review, and sends selected prospect records to the user's CRM, with per-email approval for Gmail outreach. Marquorum is an affiliate network for creators promoting Agentic Services, with tracked links and payout reporting. The Akii SEO Plugin is a free toolkit for Claude Code that audits sites, checks broken links, compares pages with competitors, works on titles and structured data, and builds content plans. Entreprehardship is a podcast with Josef Holm about the personal cost of entrepreneurship.
notable: Free MIT-licensed Akii SEO Plugin that runs inside a Claude Code session
Revenue Scout requires approval of each Gmail email before it is queued
Marquorum affiliate network promotes Agentic Services with tracked links and payouts
Entreprehardship podcast hosted by Josef Holm
caveats: Revenue Scout sends emails only after the user approves each one, and the user posts social replies from their own account
Marquorum earnings depend on the current terms and qualifying payments
Page does not give pricing details for Revenue Scout or Marquorum
